source: Shipped Flutter UI (package `rectify`) rendered from real widgets, routes, and state under the French app bundle. No marketing mockups, no fabricated screens.
captureMethod: flutter test widget harness on the host VM: RepaintBoundary.toImage(pixelRatio: 3) -> ui.ImageByteFormat.png -> File. Demo mode (offline, no network) drives the canonical 6-event calculation through the real calculation_flow controller and go_router routes; the device locale is forced to fr so MaterialApp resolves the French ARB bundle exactly as a French device would.
network: none (demo mode is fully offline; no network calls, no HTTP)
captionPlanSource: CURRENT post-Appeeky five-frame store story. Captions are baked into final files under composited/, not into the raw frames.
currentCaptionPlanSource: docs/store-listing-tier1-localized.md §3 (post-Appeeky localized five-frame plan; near-native reviewed 2026-07-02)

shareTextPayload.textPayloadNote: The fixed share prose and confidence label are localized through AppLocalizations; the brand and public share URL are held constant. Dynamic result values come from the calculation data, and the demo ascendant token is data-supplied.
shareTextPayload.privacySafe: Contains only estimated time + rising sign + confidence + brand + public share URL. No birth date, no birthplace, no life events, no PII.
shareTextPayload.exactText:
Mon résultat d'heure de naissance avec TrueRise :
7:14 AM · Ascendant Gemini · Niveau de confiance : 78 %

Calculé avec TrueRise : rectification de l'heure de naissance
Trouvez votre heure de naissance : https://truerise.com.ua

limitations: Raw PNGs are device-resolution captures with NO marketing caption overlays or device bezels; final caption overlays live in the composited/ directory.

The native OS share sheet cannot be captured from the host `flutter test` harness. Optional raw frame `04-share-result.png` shows the shipped in-app 'Partager le résultat' affordance; the exact text payload is recorded in shareTextPayload.exactText.

Times/signs/percentages come from the canonical offline DEMO dataset, not a live calculation. The DEMO badge is visible in-frame on the result and evidence screens, matching the honest, probabilistic framing required for store review.
iPhone 6.7" portrait only, matching the App Store 6.7-inch slot. The same harness can emit a Play / other-size variant by changing the view geometry if a second set is later required.
